___[font=Courier New]Events:[/font]
___
[font=Courier New]2 heart event: Enter in the Archaeology House between 8 and 11 am and have at least 2000g on your wallet
4 heart event: Receive the Charlie letter about the closed part of the museum, and enter in the door outside the museum between 9 am and 2 pm. Must be sunny.
6 heart event: receive the letter about a 'secret' and enter in the mines between 11 am and 3 pm.
8 heart event: go to the beach between 8 and 12 am
10 heart event: Receive the letter about a conversation and go to the shop between 9 am and 4 pm.
14 heart event: Receive the letter about the shop, and go there between 9 and 10 am.

--------------------------------------------
__![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/750417894667452476/install-instructions.png)﻿﻿__

Install the latest version of SMAPI, CP, TMXL Map toolkit, ShopTileFramework, Anti-Social Npcs, and then drop into your mods folder.

QuestFramework is optional.

To uninstall, just remove the _[ME] Museum Expansion_ folder and it's done!

--------------------------------------------

__![](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/706940440372445255/750418038628679740/compatibility.png)﻿﻿
__
It is compatible with SVE
It is compatible with Reimagined 2
It is compatible with Karmylla
It works on android too
